meta.goal: Complete the trust-critical marketplace flows and make business rules configurable before public soft launch.
meta.summary: Dev and UAT Cloud Run environments are live with separate Cloud SQL instances, per-environment secrets in Secret Manager, and per-environment runtime identities. Email-only access (PR #17), mutual cancellation (PR #19), server-side gig visibility (PR #21), and Resend email delivery (PR #23) are live on dev and UAT; real-mailbox verification and password reset work. Configurable platform settings backend (PR #26) is on dev and promoted with the 2026-10-19 docs update. Repo housekeeping on 2026-10-19 left only dev and main, no open PRs, and archived stale branches as archive/* tags. Remaining gaps: CI test gate, least-privilege deploy identity, UAT backups, contract timers, evidence/arbitration, admin app, billing, uploads, production environment. Ordered plan: docs/planning/improvement-plan.md. Guides/FAQ are postponed; fixed-price only remains initial scope.

milestones.name: Reality sync & UAT deploy
milestones.exitCriteria: Dev and UAT Cloud Run environments are live on custom domains, use separate databases, and pass the smoke check; branch promotion policy is documented. Guides and FAQ are intentionally deferred.

milestones.name: UAT round 1
milestones.exitCriteria: Stakeholder feedback collected and triaged; blocking bugs fixed; docs cleanup plan executed.

milestones.name: Deal lifecycle completion
milestones.exitCriteria: Email-only eligibility rules are implemented; mutual cancellation request/consent flow is complete; configurable settings are editable by admins; lifecycle timers, dispute evidence/arbiter resolution, and server-side visibility rules work against documented policy snapshots; minimal admin operations are usable.

milestones.name: Money & media
milestones.exitCriteria: Configurable fee split applied on completion; billing ledger; monthly invoices with sub-1-GEL carry-over; invoice viewer; R2 uploads with EXIF stripping and MIME validation.

milestones.name: Launch hardening
milestones.exitCriteria: Production email provider works for verification and password reset; SMS is not required while phone verification is optional; gig search/filter/pagination; profile editing; reviews; e2e tests; CI smoke gate; Georgian i18n; PWA; error logging.

milestones.name: Public soft launch
milestones.exitCriteria: Go/no-go review passed; launch plan executed.

engineering.task: Create a platform_settings store so contract timeframes (48h auto-complete, 24h grace, 14d overdue, 7d dispute auto-resolve) and fee percentages (3% poster / 2% worker) are runtime-configurable, with admin API to read and update them.
engineering.notes: Backend merged to dev from feat/configurable-platform-settings. Admin-only GET/PATCH /api/v1/admin/settings with audit history; contracts snapshot settings when both parties sign; worker-quit grace uses the snapshot. Cancellation stays mutual and fee-free (PR #19). Spec: docs/specs/feat-configurable-contract-settings.md. Admin UI, timers, and billing consumers remain separate tasks.

engineering.task: Align registration, web prompts, shared guards, and API access checks so email verification is mandatory for posting/applying and phone verification is optional; cover all verification/error states.
engineering.notes: Implemented and deployed to dev in PR #17. Email is required for posting/applying; phone remains collected but optional to verify. Includes email-only guard, email OTP only, clear optional-phone copy, server resend cooldown, stable error codes, and return-to-action verification flow. Requirements: docs/specs/feat-email-required-phone-optional.md.

engineering.task: Implement production email delivery for verification OTP and password reset, including delivery failures and resend/expiry handling.
engineering.notes: Delivered in PR #23 (see the provider-integration item below). SMS provider/phone verification is optional and is not a launch blocker under the 2026-10-14 product decision.

engineering.task: Replace unilateral contract cancellation with a mutual request/accept/decline/withdraw workflow, including audit history, notifications, UI states, concurrency handling, and lifecycle regression tests.
engineering.notes: Implemented and deployed to dev in PR #19. Requests remain pending until accepted, declined, withdrawn, or superseded; mutual cancellation carries no fee. Worker quit and poster dispute remain separate. Requirements: docs/specs/feat-mutual-contract-cancellation.md.

engineering.task: Implement BullMQ background workers for contract timers: 48h auto-complete, 14-day overdue auto-complete, 7-day dispute auto-resolve — all reading timeframes from platform_settings.
Implement dispute evidence submission endpoints and arbiter resolution API (schema already exists: disputeEvidence, disputeEvidenceFiles, arbiterDecision fields).
Enforce contact-info and field visibility rules server-side in API responses (visContact etc. exist in schema but are not enforced).
engineering.notes: Implemented and deployed to dev in PR #21. Board, detail, application-history, and contract-detail responses use a shared visibility projection; public response test found no restricted values. Requirements: docs/specs/feat-server-gig-visibility.md.

engineering.task: Build minimal admin app: admin login, platform settings editor, dispute queue with arbiter resolution UI.
engineering.notes: apps/admin is currently a placeholder. Scope deliberately minimal; analytics/moderation dashboards come post-launch.

engineering.task: Implement billing ledger and fee calculation on contract completion using configurable fee percentages from platform_settings.

engineering.notes: docs/specs/feat-gig-photos.md. Owner chose Google Cloud Storage (D11). Buckets gigsge-dev-media and gigsge-uat-media. Avatars and dispute evidence can reuse processGigImage/media-storage.

engineering.task: Extend Google Cloud Storage uploads to user avatars, application attachments, and dispute evidence (private bucket + signed URLs for evidence).
Validate EXIF stripping and MIME type checks for uploaded files.
Integrate a production email provider for email verification and password reset (currently delivery is stubbed). Phone SMS is optional and not required for release.
engineering.notes: Deployed to dev in PR #23 and verified with a real mailbox (verification code and password reset). Resend delivery runs through encrypted, signed Cloud Tasks jobs, with atomic single-use reset tokens, shared Postgres HMAC-IP limiting with timing padding, and minimal reset screens. Dev runs on its own Cloud SQL instance (gigsge-dev-db); each environment has its own DB/JWT secrets, queue, and runtime service account. Follow-ups: give UAT its own Resend key (it currently copies dev's) and a dedicated DB owner instead of postgres. See docs/guides/uat-runbook.md section 3.
